shortBulletSummary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs see renewed demand, recording significant net inflows and signaling renewed institutional accumulation.
Geopolitical tensions from escalating US-Iran conflict weigh on risk assets, increasing oil prices and impacting crypto markets.
Stablecoin outflows of approximately $2.3 billion from major exchanges signal weakening BTC buying demand and reduced liquidity.
Upcoming macroeconomic events, including economic data releases and central bank decisions, are expected to drive crypto market volatility.
